AAIMS POC build reached late Phase 4 but did not fully compile, launch, or pass automated verification within the 60-turn budget.

**Completed work**
- Project scaffold: root package.json, server/, client/, tests/ directories and npm scripts (test:api, test:e2e).
- Backend (server/src/): Express API on PORT 4000 design with Three-Object Domain Model (Solution, Capability, Control) in SQLite (node:sqlite); canonical types in types.ts; governance endpoints for Requests, Meeting Decisions, Risk/NAIC Assessments, Breaches & Remediations, Compliance Audits; NAIC May Update seed data (10 Guardrails G8 DEV/DEP, AI6 practices, Working Group hierarchy).

**Not executed (Phase 4)**

**Recommended next steps (outside this session)**
1. node scripts/fix-final-tsc.mjs
2. npx tsc -p server/tsconfig.json
3. npm run build (server + client)
4. Start server and client in background; run test:api then test:e2e; fix any runtime failures.
